channel.title: Articles by Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
channel.description: Meta ads, cash on delivery, online stores and content in Egypt. What I learned running real budgets for real brands, with the numbers behind it.

item.title: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz: who I am and what I build
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: I'm Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz, founder of CTRL Solutions and UGC ARABIA. My path, the numbers behind my work, and what this blog is for.

item.title: EGP 10.9M in sales from our ads: 7 lessons from three years of Meta campaigns
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: Across 9 ad accounts, our Meta ads drove EGP 10.9M in attributed sales at 3.0X. Here's what that number hides and what it taught me.

item.title: From 1X to 16X ROAS in 30 days: how we fixed a store that was burning its budget
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: An online store was spending on Meta ads with nothing to show for it. In 30 days it made EGP 1,046,225 at 16X ROAS. What we changed, and what 16X does not mean.

item.title: The laptop campaign that returned 22X: what high-ticket products teach you about Meta ads
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: One campaign for a laptop store turned EGP 23,795 into EGP 523,700 in sales from 36 orders. Why high order values change how you read ROAS.

item.title: 28 days, 25.4K new followers, 93% organic: rebuilding a perfume page's content
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: After we took over a perfume store's page and rebuilt its content, it gained 25.4K followers and 4.1M views in 28 days, 93% of them organic. What we changed.

item.title: Meta ads for cash-on-delivery stores in Egypt: the playbook I actually use
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: How I run Meta ads for COD stores in Egypt: break-even cost per order, tracking, campaign structure, creatives, the order form and what happens after the order.

item.title: We don't run ads. We build revenue systems.
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: Ads are one step on the path from attention to a delivered order. How I map that path, where money leaks, and the tools we built to plug the leaks.

item.title: EGP 2.87 per conversation: what a cheap message campaign taught me
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: A messaging campaign for a retail brand brought 1,207 conversations at EGP 2.87 each, five times below the account average. What drives that cost.

item.title: The COD order form: fewer fields, more orders
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: The order form is where COD stores win or lose the sale. The fields I keep, the ones I remove, and the details that protect your delivery rate.

item.title: Shopify, Wuilt or a custom website? How I choose for each brand
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: We've built stores on Shopify, on Wuilt and fully custom. The questions I ask before choosing, the trade-offs of each, and when a brand should switch.

item.title: EGP 4.65M in sales for one perfume brand: what consistent scaling looks like
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: One perfume brand's ad account: EGP 4.65M in attributed sales and 3,211 orders from EGP 1.29M of spend. How the biggest campaigns held 4.2X to 4.6X at real budgets.

item.title: Why I report a blended 3.0X, and what it hides
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: Our blended return across 9 Meta ad accounts is 3.0X. How it's calculated, why I don't hide the weak accounts, and why no single brand lives at the average.

item.title: Sales objective or messages objective? How I choose for Egyptian brands
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: When I run Meta sales campaigns for website orders and when I run messaging campaigns for WhatsApp and Messenger, with real numbers from the accounts we manage.

item.title: Why UGC sells better than polished ads
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: Why videos made by real people often outsell studio ads in Egypt and the Arab world, what makes a UGC video work, and why I built a platform for UGC creators.

item.title: From content creator to agency founder: what each step taught me
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: I started as a content creator, then became a social media specialist and a media buyer before founding CTRL Solutions. What each role taught me.

item.title: Same campaign, six cities: why a conversation cost EGP 8 in one and EGP 32 in another
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: A perfume retail chain ran the same messaging campaign around six branches. Cost per conversation ranged from EGP 8.48 to EGP 31.67. Here's why.

item.title: Confirming COD orders on WhatsApp: the follow-up that protects your delivery rate
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: In cash on delivery, an order is a promise until someone confirms it. How I set up order confirmation on WhatsApp and by phone, what to say, and what to track.

item.title: Meta Pixel and Conversions API for cash-on-delivery stores: a practical setup
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: How I set up the Meta Pixel and Conversions API for COD stores in Egypt: when to fire Purchase, values, deduplication and the checks before spending.

item.title: Reels that sell: the five-part structure we use
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: The structure I use for reels and video ads that turn views into orders: hook, desire, proof, offer and the next step, with formats that work for Egyptian buyers.

item.title: What an ERP for a perfume business must do
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: We built ERP and POS systems for perfume businesses with branches. The features that matter, from barcodes and wholesale prices to daily reports.

item.title: 89% of our sales came from 3 accounts. Here's what that taught me.
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: Three of our nine ad accounts produced 89% of EGP 10.9M in attributed sales, from 72% of the spend. What separates the top accounts from the rest.

item.title: 6.3X on a perfume store campaign: 168 orders from EGP 33,700
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: A single sales campaign for a perfume store returned 6.3X: 168 orders and EGP 213,720 in sales from EGP 33,744. How it compares with the account's earlier campaigns.

item.title: How I test creatives every week without burning the budget
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: My weekly creative testing routine on Meta: how many ads to test, where to put them, which numbers to read first, and when to pause or scale.

item.title: Why I named my agency CTRL
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: The story behind the name CTRL Solutions: why brand owners need control more than another vendor, and how five keyboard shortcuts organize our services.

item.title: How to reduce refused deliveries in cash on delivery
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: Refused parcels quietly eat COD margins. The usual reasons buyers say no at the door, and the fixes I apply before the ad, at the order form and after the order.

item.title: Launching an online store in Egypt: the checklist we follow
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: The checklist we use before launching an online store in Egypt: payments and cash on delivery, shipping, product pages, tracking, alerts and first ads.

item.title: How to brief a UGC creator (and get content you can actually use)
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: Most disappointing UGC comes from a weak brief. What I put in every brief: the one message, must-say points, hooks, format, dialect, deliverables and usage rights.

item.title: 48,913 conversations for a laptop store: running Meta messaging ads at scale
item.dc:creator: Islam Mohamed Abdelaziz
item.description: A laptop store's messaging ads brought 48,913 conversations at EGP 13.93 on average, and EGP 3.50 at best. What moved the cost between campaigns.

item.title: 101,000 conversations later: the questions Egyptian buyers ask before they order

item.description: Our Meta campaigns started 101,000+ messaging conversations. The questions buyers ask again and again, and how to answer them before they ask.

item.title: Smart retargeting: how to follow up with buyers without annoying them
